newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA'S FEMCO SAYS GENAIRE TALKS ONGOING.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA'S FEMCO SAYS GENAIRE TALKS ONGOING.

text.p: South African elecric motor and components firm Femco Technology Holdings Ltd said on Friday talks were still ongoing on a change of control at the group.
The firm said shareholders were advised to exercise caution in their dealings until a further announcement is made.

On July 8 the firm said Genaire Holdings had agreed to take a controlling interest in it. Genaire would take a 58.45 percent share in Femco, if approved in terms of the takeovers and mergers laws, a company notice said then.
